summary: Right upper-to-mid lung zone develops a patchy focal density on the current image that was not present in the prior at the same level.

findings.rationale: Matched by rib and hilar alignment, the prior right upper-mid lung shows a fine reticular pattern without focal density; the current image at the same level shows a new patchy, more confluent opacity, not explained by rotation or exposure since the contralateral lung and mediastinum are comparable.
